title: Zesty Smoked Portuguese Chicken Tagine
description: A flavorful, paleo-friendly Portuguese dish made with smoked paprika, served in a pandan leaf wrap. Perfect for a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, mustard powder, and garlic powder.
Heat the olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lemon juice and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the tagine to the preheated oven and cook for 25 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Meanwhile, prepare the pandan leaf wraps by soaking them in water for 5 minutes.
To assemble the dish, place a portion of the chicken and sauce onto a pandan leaf and fold the leaf to form a wrap.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
